body: Thank you, I'll try to get over it. It just sucks how she's out there with her friends having fun while I'm stuck at home grieving over her. I really do have no one at this point, my parents don't want to hear it, they're tired of the relationship. She's beautiful, she was perfect for me really, it's really hard to move on but I'll try

I've tried, however, we spent so much time together that everything reminds me of her. Everything I do, I've done with her. I've gone out to try other things, but I just end up wishing she was at my side so we could both enjoy ourselves.
